steps.name: reload the keys page; the raw secret is NOT on screen anywhere

steps.observed: endpoint registered (id captured)

steps.observed: endpoint active=false; the Console says so on screen=true

steps.name: enable it again
steps.observed: endpoint active=true

steps.name: balances page loads and shows the project’s real figures
steps.observed: http 200; no balances exist yet and the page shows the financial-setup state rather than a fabricated 0 Kz (invented zero=false)

steps.observed: http 200; renders the project's transaction surface (financial-setup state — no transactions exist yet)

steps.observed: GET /v1/me with the same key: 200 before revocation -> 401 after

steps.name: create a successor key by rotation and prove the successor works
steps.observed: successor /v1/me -> 200, rotated-away predecessor -> 401, secrets differ=true

steps.observed: of the journey's own keys: 1 active, 2 revoked (4 on the project in total); the table shows both "Ativa" and "Revogada"=true

steps.observed: ID=uuid(true), AMBIENTE="Sandbox", CRIADO="2026-09-12 12:41 UTC"

steps.observed: Projeto arquivado. 1 chave revogada.

steps.name: the archived project’s authority is gone: its remaining key fails at the Gateway
steps.observed: the key that worked at step 42 now answers 401

steps.name: the archived project leaves the default selector and returns behind "Mostrar arquivados"
steps.observed: hidden by default=true; behind "Mostrar arquivados" it returns labelled "(arquivado)"=true

steps.name: workspace settings: remove the second member
steps.observed: workspace is back to one member

steps.name: archive the workspace: refused while an active project remains, then succeeds
steps.observed: refusal named the count=true ("Este workspace ainda tem projetos ativos. Arquive-os primeiro."), workspace unchanged by the refusal (ACTIVE); after archiving the project it closed -> no longer listed

steps.name: sign out: confirmation appears, Cancel keeps the session, confirming ends it
steps.observed: modal shown, Cancel kept the session (/auth/me 200), confirm ended it (/auth/me 401); Back -> /login blocked=true; second tab -> /login blocked=true

secret_scan_note: The secret is counted only from the moment the reveal-once dialog was acknowledged and dismissed. The creation response itself legitimately carries it — that IS the one reveal — so the scan measures whether it is recoverable AFTERWARDS, which is the property the product claims.
secrets_note: No raw API key, webhook signing secret, session cookie, CSRF token, OTP or proof reference is printed or stored by this suite. Credentials are asserted on shape and on their masked rendering.
